overview: Richmond, Virginia is a strong base for travelers who want a concise mix of landmark stops, local neighborhoods, and outdoor time. Start each day with one anchor attraction, then add a nearby activity to reduce transit time and keep your Richmond itinerary efficient while still feeling varied and local.

travelTips: Group activities by area to reduce transfers across Richmond.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for Richmond?
faq.a: Two to three days is enough for core Richmond highlights plus one or two local experiences.
